aggregation: sum of each case's median complete native alignment time over 7 repetitions plus median per-scope batch setup+teardown; bootstrap allocates that overhead equally across the 192 cases
batch_scope: each invocation contains exactly one 192-case scope, one repetition; WFA workspace setup/teardown shared within that scope; all I/O and CIGAR verification outside measured native scope

bootstrap.limitation: eight independent genomic windows; CI does not represent platform, genome or hardware generalization
bootstrap.unit: reference locus with nested lengths and all event/noise variants retained together; matched controls share cluster

warmup: one discarded 192-case invocation for each method and scope before all timed repetitions; timed invocations create fresh WFA workspaces
